card.name: Linking words in premedication lists
card.fires_on: Small linking words or punctuation (and, with, such as, commas) right after premedicate/pretreat or inside a list of premedication drugs, just before the next drug such as acetaminophen, antihistamine or corticosteroid.

modes.label: Between premedication drugs
modes.description: A comma or 'and' joining drugs in a premedication list.
modes.example: Premedicate patients with acetaminophen<<,>> anti-histamine, and a gluc

modes.label: After premedicate verb
modes.description: 'with' or 'such as' introducing the premedication drugs.
modes.example: Premedicate<< with>> an antihistamine and antipy

card.writes: It seems to push toward the start of the next premedication drug name (such as antipyretic or antihistamine) rather than other words.
card.plain: It marks the spot in infusion-reaction instructions where the next premedication drug is about to be named.
